summary.zh: 计算客户应收账龄，匹配未认领银行到账，形成催收优先级和需要人工审核的沟通草稿。
summary.en: Calculates receivables aging, suggests bank-receipt matches and prepares prioritized, reviewable collection drafts.

zh: 未清项与银行到账快照
争议或冻结客户进入人工复核
en: Disputed or blocked accounts route to review

description.zh: 识别周催收清单、客户账龄或未匹配到账问题，并抽取客户范围。
description.en: Classifies weekly collection, customer-aging or unmatched-receipt requests.

description.zh: 读取客户、未清项、付款历史、信用敞口与未认领到账。
description.en: Loads customers, open items, payment history, credit exposure and unclaimed receipts.

purpose.zh: 统一 SAP/fixture 只读数据边界
purpose.en: Unified read-only SAP or fixture boundary

purpose.zh: 人工核对应收、信用和银行到账
purpose.en: Human verification of receivables, credit and bank receipts

description.zh: 按 current、1-30、31-60、61-90、90+ 天对未清项分桶。
description.en: Buckets open items into current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 90+ days.

purpose.zh: 可复现的自然日账龄计算

description.zh: 根据参考号、金额、付款人和日期给出 exact、likely 或 unmatched 结论。
description.en: Uses references, amount, payer and date to classify exact, likely or unmatched candidates.

purpose.zh: 生成可解释候选，不执行清账

description.zh: 结合逾期、历史付款、信用使用率和待匹配到账生成风险分与行动优先级。
description.en: Combines delinquency, payment history, credit utilization and pending receipts into risk and priority.

description.zh: 生成催收草稿或内部复核任务，明确禁止自动外发。
description.en: Creates a collection draft or internal review task with auto-send disabled.

purpose.zh: 编排并返回版本化 JSON
